signal_stage.reasoning: Selected 20 long candidates with the highest magnitude scores and positive direction, avoiding those with prior loss warnings (S, UVN, AROC). Short candidates selected from the highest magnitude negative direction stocks, also avoiding warned names (LXK, UIS, CTXS). The grind_up regime supports aggressive long selection and cautious short selection.
signal_stage.regime_adjustment: In grind_up regime, we favored long candidates with strong magnitude and direction to ride momentum, and for shorts we required high magnitude to avoid premature entries in a rising market. Loss-warned tickers were excluded unless signal quality was exceptional, which was not the case given the lack of confirming indicators.
